## Context / Problem

Current-base archaeology shows that `src/rebar/_cli/_registry.py:414-418` registers `review-code`, `review-plan`, and `sign-review`, but no bare `review` command. `docs/exit-codes.md:184`, `AGENTS.md:239-240`, and `docs/repo-snapshot-gates.md:3` each still claim that bare `review` is a deprecated forwarding shim or retained alias. Those maintained pages misstate the current CLI contract.

## Approach

Delete the stale bare-`review` entry from `docs/exit-codes.md`. Rewrite the stale AGENTS LLM-operations guidance and `docs/repo-snapshot-gates.md` CLI-form list to describe only live commands: `review-plan`, `review-code`, `sign-review` where applicable, `verify-completion`, and `scan-spec`. Retain accurate live-command exit-code rows unchanged except for immediately necessary table formatting. Do not add a command-reference generator and do not change the CLI registry: source inspection is the verification boundary, not an implementation target.

## Scope

- `docs/exit-codes.md` — remove the stale deprecated `review` shim row.
- `AGENTS.md` — remove or rewrite the stale claim that bare `review` forwards to `review-plan`.
- `docs/repo-snapshot-gates.md` — remove bare `review` from its CLI forms and delete the retained-alias claim.
- Read-only verification: `src/rebar/_cli/_registry.py` establishes the live command set.

## Testing

Run the existing documentation checks. Confirm the registry has no bare `review` route and run an anchored maintained-guidance search, `rg -n 'rebar review($|[^-])' AGENTS.md README.md docs`, so `review-plan` and `review-code` cannot create false positives. Search the three edited pages for the deprecated-forwarding and retained-alias wording.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `docs/exit-codes.md` contains no row or prose that presents bare `review` as an available or forwarding CLI command.
- [ ] `AGENTS.md` contains no claim that bare `review` forwards to `review-plan`.
- [ ] `docs/repo-snapshot-gates.md` does not list bare `review` as a CLI form or retained alias.
- [ ] The documented `review-code`, `review-plan`, and `sign-review` exit-code rows remain accurate and present.
- [ ] Anchored maintained-guidance search finds no bare `rebar review` invocation; `rebar review-plan` and `rebar review-code` are not false positives.
- [ ] Existing documentation checks pass without expanding command-reference generation ownership.
